english: true grief is a private matter

terms.latin: Ille dolet vērē quī sine teste dolet.
terms.comment: Literally “he truly grieves who grieves without a witness”. We have found no ancient source for it in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
